title: Lulu and the Moon in the Pond | Bedtime Story for Kids
description:
The sun goes down and Lulu sees a moon in the pond. Did it fall in?
Frog says: look up, Lulu! The moon is in the sky. The still pond is like a mirror.
Little Fish swims by and the moon in the water wiggles. Good night, Moon!
A calm bedtime story for children aged 3 to 6.
